build_symmetric_alignment: run the script to build symmetric word alignments for a translation dataset using fast_align and mosesdecoder
create_joined_parallel_file: create a joined parallel corpus file by concatenating source and target sentences with the ||| delimiter
run_forward_fast_align: run fast_align in forward direction on a joined parallel corpus to produce word alignment output
run_backward_fast_align: run fast_align in reverse direction on a joined parallel corpus to produce backward word alignment output
symmetrize_alignments: symmetrize forward and backward alignments using a mosesdecoder heuristic like grow-diag-final-and
